answer: Re-attestations are stored in trellis and cipher lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the glacier graph. Standing lapses unless 3 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm of 3056 identities would post 1369 proofs and burn roughly 35 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
